description: Register an SSHResource (run_command over a real paramiko SSH connection) for use by other components -- the Airflow SSHOperator equivalent as reusable, injectable logic.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components/assets reference it via resource_key.

host_env_var.label: Host Env Var
host_env_var.description: Env var containing the SSH host/IP.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var containing the SSH username.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var containing the SSH password. Fallback when no private key option is set.

private_key_env_var.label: Private Key Env Var
private_key_env_var.description: Env var containing PEM-encoded private key content.

private_key_path_env_var.label: Private Key Path Env Var
private_key_path_env_var.description: Env var containing a path to a private key file already on disk. Takes precedence over private_key_env_var when both are set.

known_hosts_check.label: Known Hosts Check
known_hosts_check.description: When False (default), accept any host key (AutoAddPolicy). When True, use the system known_hosts file and reject unknown host keys.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Default connection + per-command timeout in seconds.

name: SSH Resource
